title: Active Inference for Built Environments & CooperActive Systems
subtitle: Applying Active Inference to designing, managing, and evolving built environments.
audience: Architects, urban systems designers, and researchers interested in distributed intelligence and digital twins for the built environment.
lede: This Ecosystem project applied Active Inference to designing, managing, and evolving built environments that prioritize the flourishing of all life, via distributed intelligence and digital twins.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: The project explored how distributed intelligence and digital-twin approaches, framed through Active Inference, could support built environments designed and managed for the flourishing of all life rather than for a single optimization target. The project is now archived.
